purpose: 40 ms固定と8.8周期比例の開始自然さを160 Hz・300 Hzで比較する

selection_rule.cycle: cycle is preferred in both duplicate presentations at both pitches
selection_rule.fixed: cycle criterion is not met and no pitch consistently prefers cycle against a fixed preference at the other pitch
selection_rule.pitch_dependent: one pitch consistently prefers fixed and the other consistently prefers cycle
selection_rule.inconclusive: duplicate preferences disagree or an identity/artifact gate fails
selection_rule.same_tiebreak: retain fixed 40 ms for lower complexity
